steps.content: [Chromatic Passage]
Once again, you return to the Void of Yin, and the dark passage is still the first thing to meet you. It lies in total silence, only a cold wind rushing up from its depths.
Fear no longer holds you.
You extend your hand and let the shackles be your only guiding light.
[Surface World - Anomaly]

The ritual is complete. Now he only needs to step into the formation and fuse with the half of his soul still trapped within the Void of Yin. To set foot in the underworld through the arts of righteousness: it is the most perilous of all forbidden practices recorded in the Daoist texts. Even Li Xianling has no knowledge of it.
Perhaps, the instant his soul is made whole, he will grasp a sliver of survival. Or perhaps he will stay in the Void of Yin forever, neither alive nor dead.
<i>Should he cast one more divination?
He rummages inside his robes, but the three copper coins he uses for divination are gone. Some wandering phantom must have swiped them during the chaos.
No matter. There have already been more than enough surprises along the way, and his final fate won't be altered by this. And yet, amidst all of that...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You saw it too, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That people can stand against the calamities with their own two hands. It was never just some delusion of mine.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Heh.
Golden light ripples to life beneath his feet.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Keep monitoring the camp's signal. If you get a response, don't wait for us.
He opens his mouth, but no sound escapes. His feet are leaden, rooted to the spot.
Sensing it, Chengxiao offers an apologetic smile and taps Keylan lightly on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Don't worry. We'll catch up soon enough. We'll all make it home together.

steps.speaker: Keylan
steps.content: ...I understand. I believe in you.
Chengxiao only smiles and offers no reply.
A moment later, something seems to occur to him. He retrieves his terminal and passes it to Keylan.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Ah. One more thing before I go.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Tell those who still come seeking answers from the heavens to stop putting their faith in gods and immortals. The great Celestial Master of the Tianyi Sect died long ago on the path to saving this world. And never once looked back.
No sooner does the terminal land in Keylan's grip than it vibrates violently, almost tumbling to the ground.
When he lifts his head again, Chengxiao's silhouette is already fading, consumed by the fissure.
